title: Parloa triples its valuation in 8 months to $3B with $350M raise
description: The massive round was led by existing investor General Catalyst, with participation from other returning backers.
author: Marina Temkin

title: After Italy, WhatsApp excludes Brazil from rival chatbot ban
description: WhatsApp is allowing AI providers to continue offering their chatbots to users in Brazil, days after the country's competition agency ordered the company to suspend its new policy that bars third-party, general-purpose chatbots from the app.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Mira Murati’s startup, Thinking Machines Lab, is losing two of its co-founders to OpenAI
description: The abrupt change in personnel was in the works for several weeks, according to an OpenAI executive.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: India’s Emversity doubles valuation as it scales workers AI can’t replace
description: Emversity has raised $30 million in a new round as it scales job-ready training in India.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Musk denies awareness of Grok sexual underage images as California AG launches probe
description: The California attorney general has opened a formal investigation into Elon Musk's xAI after its chatbot Grok began generating nonconsensual sexual images of real women and even children.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI signs deal, worth $10B, for compute from Cerebras
description: The collaboration will help OpenAI's models deliver faster response times for more difficult or time-consuming tasks, the companies said.
author: Lucas Ropek
